instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: I try to pick up packages at a delivery office or a pickup locker. That way, I don't cause trouble with redelivery. It's handy to pick them up when it works for me, but some products can't be sent to a pickup locker. Even if I ask for a package to go to a delivery office, it can arrive late, so sometimes, in the end, I have to receive it in person. Still, I honestly think it's wrong that I pay the same fees as people who are always out and ask for redelivery. I'm the one who thinks about how to get my packages and takes the trouble. Redelivery uses the delivery worker's time, so I think it's fine to charge for it. I'd be okay with making the first redelivery free. People who are repeatedly out could pay for it. Maybe that's only my view, though, because the delivery office is nearby and I can choose how to get my packages.
